newsitem.title: USA: Kmart says performance below plan.
newsitem.headline: Kmart says performance below plan.

text.p: Kmart Corp, which earlier reported its same-store sales rose one percent during August, said Thursday the performance was weaker than expected.
"While these sales results are improved from July's levels, Kmart's performance remains below plan," said Floyd Hall, Kmart's chairman, president and chief executive.
"August back to school sales were satisfactory in denim and basic apparel, although sales of women's apparel continued to be soft," Hall said in a statement.
Business was strong in menswear, stationery, paint, electronics, health and beauty aids and pharmacy departments, he added.
Last month, Kmart reported same-store sales fell 3.8 percent during the month of July. Same-store sales at U.S. Kmart general merchandise stores fell 3.7 percent during July.
